Congrats again on the upcoming Phoenix Health announcement — excited to be part of it. Wanted to align on a few practical items so Redwood's communications and product teams can prepare the media kit and quote approvals:

Suggested quote (short):
"Redwood Inference is proud to support Phoenix Health as they modernize clinical workflows with real-time inference. Their team moved quickly to production, and our platform helped them scale without compromising safety or compliance."

Thanks — both drafts look fine from a legal perspective. A couple of small notes:

- Keep language generic on "scale" and "safety" rather than any operational metrics.
- Remove any implication that Redwood accesses PHI; we should include a sentence about customer control over data if Phoenix wants it in the kit. Draft suggestion: "Phoenix Health retains control of patient data and configures model access consistent with their compliance policies."

Tom — FYI per Alyssa's earlier note re: metric claims. If Phoenix legal wants a redline I can accept and return within a few hours.
